The option defaults to false, preserving existing HTTP behavior as

option leaves that server selection unchanged. Document the option and
add its EggAppConfig type.

Tests cover omitted/false/true configuration, with and without
debugPort, plus the framework's false default. Real cluster tests cover
HTTP with default and explicit hostnames and HTTPS; both endpoints
respond and both ports are released after shutdown.

Validation on Windows, Node.js 22.23.2:
- Focused cluster tests: debug-port.test.ts, worker-protocol.test.ts,
and https.test.ts — 26 passed.
- Framework configuration tests — 2 passed.

default/false compatibility regressions to fail, with the remaining 18
protocol tests passing.

--type-check passed with three pre-existing redundant-union warnings in
packages/egg/src/lib/types.ts. All changed files were formatted with

The runs use the package Vitest entry points and original configurations
with the existing focused dependency environment; this is not a full
monorepo installation or suite. The first sandbox-user attempts failed
before applications started because os.userInfo() returned

user. Two final test typing annotations were checked by type-aware lint
after the successful runtime runs. No coverage percentage is claimed;
the updated CI/Codecov result is still required.

AI-assisted follow-up implementation and validation summary (GPT-6).

Follow-up validation for `8ab7b0b`: independent HTTP and HTTPS debug
listeners now route bind errors through the existing startup
log/worker-exit handler. The default shared HTTP listener retains
exactly one handler. Native occupied-port regressions live in a separate
file from the mocked protocol tests.

On Windows with Node.js 24.15.0 and the existing focused dependencies,
all 28 tests in worker-protocol, debug-port, https and debug-port-error
pass. Restoring only the preceding production source makes both
occupied-port regressions fail with real EADDRINUSE errors; the final
source was restored byte-for-byte. Cluster typecheck and final
three-file type-aware lint pass with no warnings. The earlier two
configuration tests are unchanged and were not repeated for this
handler-only follow-up. This remains focused local validation; updated
upstream CI/Codecov is pending.
